featured_reviews.review_text:
The gym overall has a great look and feel and genuinely gives off a strong community vibe, which was one of the main reasons I decided to visit. Unfortunately, the experience at the reception completely ruined that first impression.

I had booked a free trial on May 15th (Friday) and was expecting a callback as mentioned in the instructions. Due to personal commitments, I could only finally visit on May 20th regarding(Tuesday), despite never receiving any call for the trial.

What happened at the reception was honestly disappointing and insulting. Initially, the One of the staff outright denied that any free trial even exist now and instead pushed for a paid day pass for 400Rs. Only later did the other  receptionist came and acknowledged that a free trial is offered. While speaking to her superior over the call, she openly said things like “The opposite side gym is closed today because of XYZ reason, should we  give the free trial?” — and this entire conversation happened right in front of "Another Customer". Superior on the call was kind of enough to offer free trial which I denied taking due to such negative experience.

Instead of handling the situation professionally and simply asking basic questions like *when the trial was booked* or checking the details properly, I was subjected to completely unnecessary and irrelevant questioning. The entire interaction made me feel as though I was doing something wrong or trying to scam the gym just for asking about a trial that was officially offered and booked beforehand.

Rating: ★★★★☆ (4/5)
​The Bottom Line:
This is an unbiased and independent review of JK Fitness. Overall, the gym offers a very polished experience for a neighborhood facility. While the basement setting imposes some spatial limits, smart organization and high maintenance standards make it a solid choice.

​Facility & Atmosphere
​Cleanliness & Lighting: The gym scores high on hygiene. The space is notably clean and well-lit, avoiding the dingy feel sometimes associated with basement gyms.

​Layout: Although located in a basement and described as "compact," the layout is efficient. The equipment is placed strategically to maximize floor space, so it doesn't feel cramped even during a workout.

​Amenities: There is a TV on the floor, which is a nice addition. The gym mats are of good quality, and mirror placements are decent.

​Equipment & Training
​Maintenance: The equipment is the highlight here—everything is in excellent condition and feels well-cared for.
​Staff: The trainers appear competent and approachable, contributing to a positive environment.

​Logistics (Parking & Storage)
​Storage: Policies are straightforward—footwear is kept outside, while gym bags can be brought inside. This helps keep the workout floor clean.

​Parking: I parked my scooter right outside the society gate (in the bank parking area), which felt safe enough. However, finding a spot for a car could be tricky here.
​Suggestions

​Ventilation: The temperature is generally fine, though adding an AC unit or fan specifically over the dumbbell area would be a nice touch to make that section even more comfortable.

​Verdict
If you are looking for a clean, well-maintained facility with good equipment organization, JK Fitness is a reliable option.

No Refund Policy:

I enrolled for a membership at MaxOut Gym (Daulat Nagar) on 01 June 2026. On 02 June 2026, I requested a GST invoice for reimbursement purposes, but the receipt provided was not a GST-compliant invoice and was rejected by my employer.

Since only one day had passed from enrollment and I had not used any gym facilities, attended any sessions, or availed any services, I approached the gym and requested a refund. I was informed that refunds are not provided once a membership is enrolled, regardless of whether the services have been used.

I discussed the matter with the gym owner, who offered alternatives such as transferring the membership or converting the amount into personal training services for my wife. While I appreciate the attempt to provide alternatives, these options did not address my request for a refund, especially considering that no services had been utilized and the issue arose immediately after enrollment.

My concern is not about a refund after using the gym's facilities, but about the lack of flexibility in handling a request made within 24 hours of enrollment and before any services were consumed (No Cooling Period).

I would recommend that prospective members ask about the gym's refund policy, invoice/GST documentation process, transfer rules, and cancellation terms before making payment.

I hope the management reviews such cases individually and considers a customer-friendly resolution process for situations where services have not yet been used even that too in the early stage when they just started the business.

I am not complaining about the facilities but about the Policy and the Management.

Conversation dated: 11 June 2026 as below -

I am increasing my Google rating because the owner (Vikram) and Pranita contacted me and requested that I change my rating to 4 or 5 stars.

However, I am genuinely struggling to understand how I can provide such a rating when I have not used any of the gym facilities, attended any sessions, or experienced the services firsthand.

What concerns me further is that Pranita informed me that the owner is considering cancelling the credit note that was previously offered, allegedly because of the rating I posted. As a result, I feel pressured to increase my rating despite my unresolved concerns.

I believe customer ratings should be based on actual experience and service quality rather than being influenced by requests to change ratings. I leave it to others to decide whether this is an appropriate way to handle customer feedback and concerns.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this with deep frustration and genuine concern for the safety and rights of members. This gym has proven to be by far the most poorly managed, negligent, & misleading fitness establishment I have ever been associated with. From the very first day, the experience has been consistently negative, marked by operational failures, false commitments, and utter lack of accountability.
1.	Trainer negligence leading to injury: Due to inexperienced trainers & poor supervision, I suffered a severe neck injury, resulting in more than three months of recovery. This happened during a paid personal training session — something that should have been safe and professionally handled.
2.	False advertising of classes: Zumba, Yoga, Pilates, and Bollywood Dance sessions are irregular, frequently canceled, and often happen without any notice. What they promote in their brochure and what they actually deliver are completely different.
3.	Extremely delayed maintenance: It took them three months to repair the ice bath tub, and even then, they refused to extend memberships or compensate members for the downtime. This reflects their complete disregard for customer rights.
4.	Poor air-conditioning: The gym floor often feels like a furnace because of ineffective or non-functional air conditioning. Despite repeated complaints, there is no resolution.
5.	Lack of basic equipment: The gym has only 2 barbell locks for 5 machines. If you request more, you’re passed from one staff member to another, and the issue remains unresolved. This is basic gym infrastructure, not a luxury. Its been a month since the request was placed.
6.	Non-functional steam room: The steam facility hardly works. A staff member has to manually monitor the switch for it to run. It’s both unsafe and unacceptable for a premium-priced gym.
7.	Sales over safety: Trainers are more focused on aggressively pushing personal training packages than helping members with proper form, guidance, or safety.
8.	Misleading personal training model: Even during a paid personal training slot, trainers frequently handle multiple clients simultaneously, turning a one-on-one session into an overcrowded group class. Members are rushed, and the quality of training is compromised. This is a clear case of misrepresentation of services.
9.	Delayed and poor-quality diet chart: Despite multiple reminders and follow-ups, I received my personal training diet chart only after 5 months of enrolling. And when it was finally shared, it was shockingly basic and generic. Something that does not reflect any personalized goal-setting or professional nutrition planning. Frankly, such a diet plan does not even qualify to be called a “chart.” This is a clear failure to deliver what was promised as part of the personal training package.
10.	Severe safety lapses: During peak hours, all treadmills abruptly stopped due to an unplanned “maintenance.” Multiple members, including me, could have been injured. This incident alone is enough to question the gym’s safety protocols.
11.	Zero accountability: When issues are escalated, staff either pass the blame or respond with scripted, robotic lines. There is no escalation matrix, no ownership, and no intent to resolve genuine member grievances.
12.	Brand endorsement is misleading: Don’t be fooled by celebrity branding. MS Dhoni is not running the operations here. The ground reality is a disorganized, unsafe, and poorly managed facility.

⸻

👉 Final Statement:
This is not just a bad experience — it’s a case of gross mismanagement, service deficiency, and potential consumer rights violation. If you’re considering joining this gym, please reconsider. There are far better-managed facilities that actually value member safety, experience, and trust.

For an establishment charging a premium, such repeated negligence, misrepresentation, and lack of accountability is unacceptable. I reserve the right to escalate this matter to consumer protection authorities and relevant fitness licensing bodies.

Choose wisely. Don’t fall for the brand name — look at the ground reality.
